author: "Jonas Mason"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

source("../../config/paths.R")

experiment_name <- "gt_100taxa_high_signal"
beast_run_name <- "dynamic_sequence_gt"

paths <- make_run_paths(experiment_name)

sim_data_path <- file.path(
  paths$sim_data_dir,
  paste0(experiment_name, "_sim_data.rds")
)

beast_output_dir <- paths$beast_output_dir
xml_dir <- paths$xml_dir

output_prefix <- experiment_name
xml_prefix <- experiment_name
```


# Purpose

This is the main XML-generation file.

Below one can choose which validation/debug/testing steps to include. If all are set to `FALSE`, the file writes a minimal XML that calls the Java operators:

```text
gentime.GenerationTimeGibbsOperator
gentime.GenerationTimeLikelihood
gentime.GenerationTimePrecisionBuilder
gentime.GenerationTimeVarianceGibbsOperator
gentime.GenerationTimeResidualVarianceGibbsOperator
gentime.GenerationTimeInverseGammaPrior
gentime.GenerationTimeTraitData
```
and the helper classes pulled internally:

```text
gentime.CSparseJSolver.java
gentime.GenerationTimeMathUtils.java
gentime.GenerationTimeTraitTransform.java
```

which are trimmed to just the essential functionalities, and will be the ones used for actual runs.

If any validation/debug/testing toggle is `TRUE`, this file writes a validation XML that calls the test versions of these files:

```text
gentime.GenerationTimeGibbsOperatorTest.java
gentime.GenerationTimeLikelihoodTest.java
gentime.GenerationTimePrecisionBuilderTest.java
gentime.GenerationTimeVarianceGibbsOperatorTest.java
gentime.GenerationTimeResidualVarianceGibbsOperatorTest.java
gentime.GenerationTimeRandomWalkOperator.java
```
and activates the requested XML options for debugging etc. 

# Settings

```{r settings}
library(ape)

if (!file.exists(sim_data_path)) {
  stop("Simulation data not found. Run 01_simulate_data.Rmd first: ", sim_data_path)
}

sim_data <- readRDS(sim_data_path)

tree <- sim_data$tree
y <- sim_data$y
dna_sequences <- sim_data$dna_sequences

prior_beta_mean <- sim_data$prior$beta_mean
prior_beta_variance <- sim_data$prior$beta_variance

scale_for_beast <- "raw"  # "raw" or "log"

chain_length <- 10000
log_every <- 1
tree_log_every <- 1000
screen_log_every <- 1000

beast_xml_path <- file.path(
  xml_dir,
  paste0(xml_prefix, "_", beast_run_name, ".xml")
)

beast_log_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_", beast_run_name, ".log")
beast_log_path <- file.path(beast_output_dir, beast_log_file)

beast_tree_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_", beast_run_name, ".trees")
beast_tree_path <- file.path(beast_output_dir, beast_tree_file)

console_log_file <- paste0(output_prefix, "_", beast_run_name, "_console.log")
console_log_path <- file.path(beast_output_dir, console_log_file)

workflow_config_path <- file.path(
  beast_output_dir,
  paste0("latest_workflow_config_", beast_run_name, ".rds")
)
```

# Validation/debug/testing options

```{r validation-options}
# Solver correctness
validate_csparsej_solver <- FALSE
pcg_tolerance <- 1e-5
# Stricter PCG tolerances like e.g. 1e-10 make the PCG reference more accurate,
# but will increase runtime substantially.

# Runtime profiling printed to Eclipse console
profile_gibbs_runtime <- FALSE
profile_frequency <- 250

# Dynamic-tree snapshot export; required for post-run precision and conditional checks
export_dynamic_snapshots <- FALSE
snapshot_frequency <- 100

# Post-run validations that require dynamic snapshots
# (Either of these set to TRUE also force snapshot export)
validate_dynamic_precision <- FALSE
validate_dynamic_conditional <- FALSE

# Frozen-tree validation requires dynamic snapshots first
prepare_frozen_tree_validation <- FALSE

# Low-level debug outputs
print_precision_refresh <- FALSE
write_latent_precision_diagnostics <- FALSE
write_posterior_mean_diagnostics <- FALSE
print_gibbs_debug <- FALSE
debug_likelihood <- FALSE
debug_trait_data <- FALSE
debug_precision_builder <- FALSE
debug_brownian_variance_gibbs <- FALSE
debug_residual_variance_gibbs <- FALSE

# Fixed tree for comparison
use_fixed_tree <- FALSE

# Brownian variance diagnostic CSV
write_brownian_variance_diagnostics <- FALSE

# Partial-write experiments
write_beta_state <- TRUE
write_generation_times_state <- TRUE
# These control whether the Gibbs operator actually writes sampled beta and/or 
# latent generation-time states back into the BEAST state. Any configuration 
# other than TRUE / TRUE is a validation/debugging experiment and automatically
# switches the XML to calling GenerationTimeGibbsOperatorTest.

# Practical implications of different combinations:
# TRUE / TRUE
#   Normal Gibbs operator behaviour
#
# FALSE / TRUE
#   Only latent generation-time states u are written.
#   -> Isolates latent-state behaviour independently of beta
#
# TRUE / FALSE
#   Only beta is written.
#   -> Useful for debugging likelihood synchronisation and operator accounting
#
# FALSE / FALSE
#   Full dry-run mode.
#   -> Gibbs calculations are performed internally, but no BEAST state is
#      changed. Useful for profiling and conditional-Gaussian diagnostics.


# Automatic consequences
export_dynamic_snapshots <- export_dynamic_snapshots ||
  validate_dynamic_precision ||
  validate_dynamic_conditional ||
  prepare_frozen_tree_validation

use_validation_java <- any(
  validate_csparsej_solver,
  profile_gibbs_runtime,
  export_dynamic_snapshots,
  validate_dynamic_precision,
  validate_dynamic_conditional,
  prepare_frozen_tree_validation,
  print_precision_refresh,
  write_latent_precision_diagnostics,
  write_posterior_mean_diagnostics,
  print_gibbs_debug,
  debug_likelihood,
  debug_precision_builder,
  debug_brownian_variance_gibbs,
  debug_residual_variance_gibbs,
  write_brownian_variance_diagnostics,
  !write_beta_state,
  !write_generation_times_state
)

needs_console_log <- any(
  validate_csparsej_solver,
  profile_gibbs_runtime
)

needs_beast_debug_vm <- any(
  print_gibbs_debug,
  debug_likelihood,
  debug_trait_data,
  debug_precision_builder,
  debug_brownian_variance_gibbs,
  debug_residual_variance_gibbs,
  validate_dynamic_conditional
)


gt_gibbs_operator_spec <- if (use_validation_java) {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeGibbsOperatorTest"
} else {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeGibbsOperator"
}

gt_likelihood_spec <- if (debug_likelihood) {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeLikelihoodTest"
} else {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeLikelihood"
}

gt_precision_builder_spec <- if (debug_precision_builder) {
  "gentime.GenerationTimePrecisionBuilderTest"
} else {
  "gentime.GenerationTimePrecisionBuilder"
}

gt_brownian_variance_gibbs_spec <- if (use_validation_java) {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeVarianceGibbsOperatorTest"
} else {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeVarianceGibbsOperator"
}

gt_residual_variance_gibbs_spec <- if (use_validation_java) {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeResidualVarianceGibbsOperatorTest"
} else {
  "gentime.GenerationTimeResidualVarianceGibbsOperator"
}




gt_likelihood_debug_attribute <- if (debug_likelihood) {
  paste0('\n                          debug="', xml_bool(debug_likelihood), '"')
} else {
  ""
}

gt_precision_builder_debug_attribute <- if (debug_precision_builder) {
  paste0('\n                                  debug="', xml_bool(debug_precision_builder), '"')
} else {
  ""
}

gt_brownian_variance_debug_attribute <- if (debug_brownian_variance_gibbs) {
  paste0('\n                  debug="', xml_bool(debug_brownian_variance_gibbs), '"')
} else {
  ""
}

gt_brownian_variance_diagnostics_attributes <- if (write_brownian_variance_diagnostics) {
  paste0(
    '\n                  tree="@tree"',
    '\n                  outputDirectory="', beast_output_dir_xml, '"',
    '\n                  writeDiagnostics="', xml_bool(write_brownian_variance_diagnostics), '"'
  )
} else {
  ""
}

gt_residual_variance_debug_attribute <- if (debug_residual_variance_gibbs) {
  paste0('\n                  debug="', xml_bool(debug_residual_variance_gibbs), '"')
} else {
  ""
}


cat("use_validation_java =", use_validation_java, "\n")
cat("gt_gibbs_operator_spec =", gt_gibbs_operator_spec, "\n")
cat("gt_likelihood_operator_spec =", gt_likelihood_spec, "\n")
cat("gt_precision_builder_spec =", gt_precision_builder_spec, "\n")
cat("gt_brownian_variance_gibbs_spec =", gt_brownian_variance_gibbs_spec, "\n")
cat("gt_residual_variance_gibbs_spec =", gt_residual_variance_gibbs_spec, "\n")
```

# XML construction helper functions

```{r xml-helpers}
xml_bool <- function(x) tolower(as.character(isTRUE(x)))

xml_path <- function(path) normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)

tip_values <- as.numeric(y)
names(tip_values) <- names(y)

if (scale_for_beast == "raw") {
  state_tip_values <- tip_values
  trait_values_for_xml <- tip_values
}

if (scale_for_beast == "log") {
  if (any(tip_values <= 0)) {
    stop("Cannot use log scale: some tip values are <= 0.")
  }
  state_tip_values <- log(tip_values)
  trait_values_for_xml <- tip_values
}

n_tips <- length(tree$tip.label)
n_nodes <- n_tips + tree$Nnode

beast_tip_order <- sort(tree$tip.label)

state_tip_values_beast_order <- state_tip_values[beast_tip_order]

initial_beta_value <- mean(state_tip_values_beast_order)
initial_residual_variance_value <- var(state_tip_values_beast_order)

generation_time_state <- rep(0.0, n_nodes)

trait_string <- paste(
  paste0(
    names(trait_values_for_xml),
    "=",
    signif(trait_values_for_xml, 12)
  ),
  collapse = ","
)

generation_time_state_string <- paste(
  signif(generation_time_state, 12),
  collapse = " "
)

newick_string <- write.tree(tree)

alignment_xml <- paste(
  c(
    '    <data id="alignment" dataType="nucleotide">',
    paste0(
      '        <sequence id="seq_',
      names(dna_sequences),
      '" taxon="',
      names(dna_sequences),
      '" value="',
      dna_sequences,
      '"/>'
    ),
    '    </data>'
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

test_only_attributes <- if (use_validation_java) {
  paste0(
    '\n                  outputDirectory="', xml_path(beast_output_dir), '"',
    '\n                  solver="csparsej"',
    '\n                  compareSolvers="', xml_bool(validate_csparsej_solver), '"',
    '\n                  maxCgIterations="10000"',
    '\n                  cgTolerance="', pcg_tolerance, '"',
    '\n                  writePosteriorMean="', xml_bool(write_posterior_mean_diagnostics), '"',
    '\n                  writeLatentPrecisionDiagnostics="', xml_bool(write_latent_precision_diagnostics), '"',
    '\n                  profile="', xml_bool(profile_gibbs_runtime), '"',
    '\n                  profileFrequency="', profile_frequency, '"',
    '\n                  printPrecisionRefresh="', xml_bool(print_precision_refresh), '"',
    '\n                  snapshotFrequency="', if (export_dynamic_snapshots) snapshot_frequency else 0, '"',
    '\n                  snapshotPrefix="gt_', beast_run_name, '_snapshot"',
    '\n                  writeBeta="', xml_bool(write_beta_state), '"',
    '\n                  writeGenerationTimes="', xml_bool(write_generation_times_state), '"',
    '\n                  debug="', xml_bool(print_gibbs_debug), '"'
  )
} else {
  ""
}
```

# XML text

```{r write-xml}
gt_state_xml <- paste0(
'
            <parameter id="generationTimes"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="', n_nodes, '"
                       value="', generation_time_state_string, '"/>

            <parameter id="brownianVariance"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="1"
                       value="1.0"
                       lower="0.0"/>

            <parameter id="beta"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="1"
                       value="', signif(initial_beta_value, 12), '"/>

            <parameter id="residualVariance"
                       name="stateNode"
                       spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                       dimension="1"
                       lower="0.0"
                       value="', signif(initial_residual_variance_value, 12), '"/>
'
)

sequence_likelihood_xml <- paste0(
'
            <distribution id="treeLikelihood"
                          spec="beast.base.evolution.likelihood.TreeLikelihood"
                          data="@alignment"
                          tree="@tree">

                <siteModel id="siteModel"
                           spec="beast.base.evolution.sitemodel.SiteModel">

                    <substModel id="jc"
                                spec="beast.base.evolution.substitutionmodel.JukesCantor"/>

                </siteModel>

                <branchRateModel id="strictClock"
                                 spec="beast.base.evolution.branchratemodel.StrictClockModel">

                    <parameter id="clockRate"
                               spec="parameter.RealParameter"
                               name="clock.rate"
                               value="', signif(sim_data$settings$jc_clock_rate, 12), '"
                               lower="0.0"/>

                </branchRateModel>

            </distribution>
'
)

gt_likelihood_xml <- paste0(
'
            <distribution id="gtLikelihood"
                          spec="', gt_likelihood_spec, '"
                          tree="@tree"
                          generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                          beta="@beta"
                          brownianVariance="@brownianVariance"
                          residualVariance="@residualVariance"
                          priorBetaMean="', prior_beta_mean, '"
                          priorBetaVariance="', prior_beta_variance, '"
                          scale="', scale_for_beast, '"', 
                          gt_likelihood_debug_attribute, '>

                <traitData id="gtData"
                           spec="gentime.GenerationTimeTraitData"
                           tree="@tree"
                           value="', trait_string, '"
                           debug="', xml_bool(debug_trait_data), '"/>

                <precisionBuilder id="gtPrecision"
                                  spec="', gt_precision_builder_spec, '"
                                  tree="@tree"', gt_precision_builder_debug_attribute, '/>

            </distribution>
'
)

tree_prior_xml <- '
            <distribution id="treePrior"
                          spec="beast.base.evolution.speciation.YuleModel"
                          tree="@tree"
                          birthDiffRate="1.0"/>
'

gt_variance_prior_xml <- '
            <distribution id="brownianVariancePrior"
                          spec="gentime.GenerationTimeInverseGammaPrior"
                          parameter="@brownianVariance"
                          alpha="2.0"
                          beta="1.0"/>

            <distribution id="residualVariancePrior"
                          spec="gentime.GenerationTimeInverseGammaPrior"
                          parameter="@residualVariance"
                          alpha="2.0"
                          beta="1.0"/>
'

gt_operator_xml <- paste0(
'
        <operator id="gtGibbs"
                  spec="', gt_gibbs_operator_spec, '"
                  tree="@tree"
                  generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                  beta="@beta"
                  brownianVariance="@brownianVariance"
                  residualVariance="@residualVariance"
                  traitData="@gtData"
                  precisionBuilder="@gtPrecision"
                  gtLikelihood="@gtLikelihood"
                  priorBetaMean="', prior_beta_mean, '"
                  priorBetaVariance="', prior_beta_variance, '"
                  scale="', scale_for_beast, '"',
                  test_only_attributes, '
                  weight="0.1"/>

        <operator id="gtBrownianVarianceGibbs"
                  spec="', gt_brownian_variance_gibbs_spec, '"
                  generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                  brownianVariance="@brownianVariance"
                  precisionBuilder="@gtPrecision"
                  gtLikelihood="@gtLikelihood"
                  priorAlpha="2.0"
                  priorBeta="1.0"',
                  gt_brownian_variance_diagnostics_attributes,
                  gt_brownian_variance_debug_attribute, '
                  weight="0.1"/>

        <operator id="gtResidualVarianceGibbs"
                  spec="', gt_residual_variance_gibbs_spec, '"
                  tree="@tree"
                  generationTimes="@generationTimes"
                  beta="@beta"
                  residualVariance="@residualVariance"
                  traitData="@gtData"
                  gtLikelihood="@gtLikelihood"
                  priorAlpha="2.0"
                  priorBeta="1.0"
                  scale="', scale_for_beast, '"',
                  gt_residual_variance_debug_attribute, '
                  weight="0.1"/>
'
)

tree_operator_xml <- '
        <operator id="treeScaler"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.ScaleOperator"
                  tree="@tree"
                  scaleFactor="0.95"
                  weight="0.05"/>

        <operator id="treeRootScaler"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.ScaleOperator"
                  tree="@tree"
                  rootOnly="true"
                  scaleFactor="0.95"
                  weight="0.05"/>

        <operator id="uniformNodeHeights"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Uniform"
                  tree="@tree"
                  weight="0.1"/>

        <operator id="narrowExchange"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Exchange"
                  tree="@tree"
                  isNarrow="true"
                  weight="0.05"/>

        <operator id="wideExchange"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.Exchange"
                  tree="@tree"
                  isNarrow="false"
                  weight="0.02"/>

        <operator id="wilsonBalding"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.operator.WilsonBalding"
                  tree="@tree"
                  weight="0.02"/>
'

screen_gt_logger_xml <- '
            <log idref="beta"/>
            <log idref="brownianVariance"/>
            <log idref="residualVariance"/>
            <log idref="clockRate"/>
'

file_gt_logger_xml <- '
            <log idref="beta"/>
            <log idref="brownianVariance"/>
            <log idref="residualVariance"/>
            <log idref="clockRate"/>
            <log id="treeHeight"
                 spec="beast.base.evolution.tree.TreeHeightLogger"
                 tree="@tree"/>
'

xml_text <- paste0(
'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<beast version="2.7"
       namespace="beast.base.inference:beast.base.evolution.tree:gentime">

', alignment_xml, '

    <run id="mcmc"
         spec="beast.base.inference.MCMC"
         chainLength="', chain_length, '">

        <state id="state">

            <tree id="tree"
                  name="stateNode"
                  spec="beast.base.evolution.tree.TreeParser"
                  newick="', newick_string, '"
                  IsLabelledNewick="true"
                  adjustTipHeights="true"/>

', gt_state_xml, '

        </state>

        <distribution id="posterior"
                      spec="beast.base.inference.CompoundDistribution">

', sequence_likelihood_xml, '
', gt_likelihood_xml, '
', if (use_fixed_tree) "" else tree_prior_xml, '
', gt_variance_prior_xml, '

        </distribution>

', gt_operator_xml, '
', if (use_fixed_tree) "" else tree_operator_xml, '

        <logger id="screenlog"
                spec="beast.base.inference.Logger"
                logEvery="', screen_log_every, '">
            <log idref="posterior"/>
', screen_gt_logger_xml, '
        </logger>

        <logger id="filelog"
                spec="beast.base.inference.Logger"
                fileName="', beast_log_file, '"
                logEvery="', log_every, '">
            <log idref="posterior"/>
', file_gt_logger_xml, '
        </logger>

        <logger id="treelog"
                spec="beast.base.inference.Logger"
                fileName="', beast_tree_file, '"
                logEvery="', tree_log_every, '"
                mode="tree">
            <log id="treeLogger"
                 spec="beast.base.evolution.TreeWithMetaDataLogger"
                 tree="@tree"/>
        </logger>

    </run>

</beast>
'
)

old_outputs <- c(
  beast_log_path,
  console_log_path,
  beast_tree_path,
  file.path(beast_output_dir, "beast_node_order.csv"),
  file.path(beast_output_dir, "beast_latent_precision_triplets.csv"),
  file.path(beast_output_dir, "brownian_variance_gibbs_diagnostics.csv")
)

unlink(old_outputs[file.exists(old_outputs)])

writeLines(xml_text, beast_xml_path)

workflow_config <- list(
  experiment_name = experiment_name,
  beast_run_name = beast_run_name,
  run_name = beast_run_name,
  output_prefix = output_prefix,
  xml_prefix = xml_prefix,
  beast_output_dir = beast_output_dir,
  beast_xml_path = beast_xml_path,
  beast_log_path = beast_log_path,
  console_log_path = console_log_path,
  use_validation_java = use_validation_java,
  gt_gibbs_operator_spec = gt_gibbs_operator_spec,
  validate_csparsej_solver = validate_csparsej_solver,
  profile_gibbs_runtime = profile_gibbs_runtime,
  export_dynamic_snapshots = export_dynamic_snapshots,
  validate_dynamic_precision = validate_dynamic_precision,
  validate_dynamic_conditional = validate_dynamic_conditional,
  prepare_frozen_tree_validation = prepare_frozen_tree_validation,
  beast_tree_file = beast_tree_file,
  beast_tree_path = beast_tree_path,
  tree_log_every = tree_log_every
  )

saveRDS(workflow_config, workflow_config_path)

cat(
  "Wrote XML to:\n",
  beast_xml_path,
  "\n\n",
  "Wrote workflow metadata to:\n",
  workflow_config_path,
  "\n\n",
  "Operator class selected:\n",
  gt_gibbs_operator_spec,
  "\n\n\n",
  "Run in Eclipse:\n\n",
  "In Run Configurations > Arguments tab:\n\n",
  "1) In the 'Program arguments' box, enter:\n\n",
  "-version_file version.xml -overwrite \"",
  xml_path(beast_xml_path),
  "\"\n\n",
  "2) In 'Working directory', select 'Other' and enter:\n\n",
  xml_path(beast_output_dir),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "\n\nRun summary:\n",
  "experiment_name: ", experiment_name, "\n",
  "beast_run_name: ", beast_run_name, "\n",
  "sim_data_path: ", sim_data_path, "\n",
  "beast_xml_path: ", beast_xml_path, "\n",
  "beast_log_path: ", beast_log_path, "\n",
  "beast_tree_path: ", beast_tree_path, "\n",
  "chain_length: ", chain_length, "\n",
  "log_every: ", log_every, "\n",
  "tree_log_every: ", tree_log_every, "\n",
  sep = ""
)

if (needs_console_log) {
  cat(
    "\n\n",
    "To save the console output, in the Run Configurations, go to the 'Common' tab, then under 'Standard Input and Output', tick 'Output File' and set the output file to:\n\n",
    console_log_path,
    "\n\n\n",
    sep= ""
  )
}

if (needs_beast_debug_vm) {
  cat(
    "Additionally, to activate BEAST's internal debug consistency checks, in the Run Configurations, go to the 'Arguments' tab, and in the 'VM arguments:' box, enter:\n\n",
    "-Dbeast.debug=true\n\n",
    "This makes BEAST repeatedly recalculate posterior components during proposals and store/restore operations to verify that operators leave the state internally consistent after accept/reject steps. Use this when debugging dynamic-tree runs, especially if we suspect posterior inconsistencies, state-sync problems, or issues after topology/node-height proposals. It will increase the runtime for BEAST's first 6000 iterations to a degree, though manageable (~1 extra minute).\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

# Post-run instructions

```{r post-run-instructions, results='asis'}
cat("\n## After the BEAST run\n\n")

if (!use_validation_java) {
  cat("- This was a minimal runtime run - no post-run validation. Continue in `09_summarise_beast_posterior.Rmd`.\n")
}

if (validate_csparsej_solver) {
  cat("- CSparseJ solver validation was activated. Continue in `03_validate_csparsej_solver.Rmd`.\n")
}

if (profile_gibbs_runtime) {
  cat("- Runtime profiling was activated. Continue in `04_profile_runtime.Rmd`.\n")
}

if (validate_dynamic_precision) {
  cat("- Dynamic snapshot precision validation was activated. Continue in `05_validate_dynamic_precision.Rmd`.\n")
}

if (validate_dynamic_conditional) {
  cat("- Dynamic conditional Gaussian validation was activated. Continue in `06_validate_dynamic_conditional_gaussian.Rmd`.\n")
}

if (prepare_frozen_tree_validation) {
  cat("- Frozen-tree validation was activated. After the dynamic BEAST run finishes, first run `06_validate_dynamic_conditional_gaussian.Rmd`. This computes how far the BEAST state deviates from the exact conditional Gaussian for each exported dynamic snapshot and saves `dynamic_conditional_gaussian_results.rds`.Then run `07_generate_frozen_tree_xml.Rmd`, which uses that file to choose which snapshot to use as the frozen-tree\n")
}
```
